entities.name: Carl Otto Mörner

entities.summary: Baron Carl Otto Mörner was a Swedish courtier, and member of the Diet. He is chiefly remembered for his role in advocating for Frenchman Jean Baptiste Bernadotte's succession to the Swedish crown in 1810.
